correctness.rationale: Exact arithmetic in Z[phi] regenerates all 30 vertices of the unit-edge regular icosidodecahedron, compares independent 3x3 and 4x4 determinant formulas on all 27405 distinct four-vertex subsets, and exhaustively verifies the 27-value histogram and 60 maxima. The unsigned maximum corresponds to (7+11 phi)/12 after scaling. The pair-codegree maximum of 3 rules out two simultaneously nonvertex corners by separate-affine determinant equality; 20 3-completion triples, with full 30-vertex supporting-plane checks, exhaust all continuous equality families. A separate 12-pyramid dissection gives volume (45+17 sqrt(5))/6 and ratio (19+7 sqrt(5))/232. A concrete equality witness is displayed and the standalone certificate was executed from the included package path. The finite program alone is not asserted to prove unrestricted continuous geometry, which follows from analytic determinant affinity and codegree.

value.rationale: This is the complete, non-artificial tetrahedral-volume spectrum of a canonical regular 30-vertex Archimedean polytope, including exact multiplicities, an affine-invariant sharp maximal tetrahedron fraction, and all continuous equality cases. Maximum inscribed simplex occupancy is a classical natural convex-geometric functional. The discovered equality locus has nontrivial two-dimensional components and cannot be inferred from merely enumerating the 60 vertex maximizers. The result offers a reproducible benchmark for maximal-simplex geometry while making no unsupported broader-theorem claim.
